headword: {広報活動|こうほうかつどう}
gloss: public relations activities; PR activities; publicity work

definitions.gloss: public relations activities; publicity work carried out by a company, government agency, or organization
definitions.explanation: The range of activities an organization undertakes to communicate information about itself or its services to the public — press releases, press conferences, social media posts, information pamphlets, advertising campaigns, and community outreach. The focus is on building understanding and a favorable image rather than on direct sales.

examples.english: We are putting effort into our public relations activities.

examples.english: With the spread of social media, even small and medium-sized companies have become able to conduct effective PR activities on a modest budget.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{広報|こうほう}→広報：05228_kouhou⟧ ('public relations; publicity') and ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ ('activity; activities'). ⟦{広報|こうほう}→広報：05228_kouhou⟧ alone is often used as a department name ({広報{部|ぶ}|こうほうぶ} 'PR department'); {広報活動|こうほうかつどう} refers to the activities carried out by such a department.

USAGE:
- Contrast with ⟦{宣伝|せんでん}→宣伝：03307_senden⟧ ('advertising; publicity') and ⟦マーケティング→マーケティング：05222_maaketingu⟧ ('marketing'): {広報活動|こうほうかつどう} emphasizes neutral information dissemination and image-building, while ⟦{宣伝|せんでん}→宣伝：03307_senden⟧ and ⟦マーケティング→マーケティング：05222_maaketingu⟧ more directly aim at sales or persuasion.
- Used by both private companies and public organizations. Local governments in particular refer to their newsletter distribution, town-hall postings, and information campaigns as {広報活動|こうほうかつどう}.
- Often paired with purposes: {認知度|にんちど}⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧ ('raising awareness'), ⟦イメージ→イメージ：03832_imeeji⟧⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧ ('image strategy'), ⟦{情報|じょうほう}{発信|はっしん}→情報発信：20545_jouhouhasshin⟧ ('information dissemination').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広報活動|こうほうかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct PR activities
- {広報活動|こうほうかつどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put effort into PR
- {広報活動|こうほうかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}する→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧: to strengthen/expand PR activities
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧な{広報活動|こうほうかつどう}: proactive PR activities
- ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広報活動|こうほうかつどう}: corporate PR activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{広報|こうほう}→広報：05228_kouhou⟧: public relations; PR — the shorter form; also refers to the PR department itself.
- ⟦{宣伝|せんでん}→宣伝：03307_senden⟧: advertising; publicity — more sales-oriented and persuasive in tone.
- PR: PR — the loanword/abbreviation, common in company slogans and recruitment ('⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧PR' = 'self-promotion').
- ⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧: advertisement; advertising — a paid message with clear commercial intent; narrower than {広報活動|こうほうかつどう}.
